summary.prompt: Which 10 open issues in vercel/next.js have the most comments? Give me the issue number, title and comment count for each.
summary.reason: 10 issue numbers, comment counts and order equal the GitHub search API result
summary.answer:
Here are the 10 open issues in vercel/next.js with the most comments, from the GitHub search API:

| # | Comments | Title |
|---|---|---|
| 49279 | 145 | [NEXT-1151] App router issue with Framer Motion shared layout animations |
| 64921 | 109 | Inconsistent CSS resolution order with App Router |
| 62008 | 88 | Debugger not binding breakpoints in VSCode in server components, using official Next.js debugger setup |
| 65335 | 83 | RSC and CDN interaction makes next.js inefficient for highload projects |
| 86577 | 81 | [cacheComponents] Activity component route preservation causes significant breakage in application logic, UI behavior and E2E tests |
| 53473 | 80 | `@next/next/no-html-link-for-pages` rule does not work with `pageExtensions` |
| 56025 | 65 | Image warning issue - If you use CSS to change the size of your image, also include the styles 'width: "auto" or 'height: "auto"' to maintain the aspect ratio |
| 42846 | 65 | Parameter on `AppType` is used incorrectly |
| 74343 | 59 | Boundary Serialization - `Props must be serializable for components in "use client" file` warning |
| 86122 | 58 | proxy.ts does not execute in production when behind Cloudflare Proxy (middleware.ts works) |

The `gh` CLI isn't authenticated in this environment, so I queried the public GitHub search API directly without a token. Search only returns issues (not PRs), and the counts are the current values from that call.
